title: Growth OS
description: A complete operating system for building and scaling your online audience through systematic content creation and distribution.
outcome: Build a repeatable audience growth system in 7 modules

modules.title: Foundation
modules.description: Establish the core infrastructure and strategic direction for your growth system.
outcome: Define your target audience with precision
Create a compelling core offer
Validate market demand before building

steps.title: Define Your Audience
steps.description: Identify exactly who you want to reach and serve with your content and offers.
steps.details: Start by getting specific about who you help. Think about demographics, psychographics, and the specific problems they face. The more specific you are, the easier it will be to create content and offers that resonate. Document their biggest frustrations, their desired outcomes, and where they currently hang out online.

steps.title: Create Your Core Offer
steps.description: Design a simple, high-value offer that solves a specific problem.
steps.details: Your core offer should be something you can deliver quickly with high value. It could be a template, a framework, a short guide, or a tool. The key is that it directly addresses a pain point your audience has. Keep it focused and avoid feature creep.

steps.title: Validate Demand
steps.description: Confirm that people actually want what you are building before going all in.
steps.details: Talk to potential customers, run a small waitlist, or create a landing page to gauge interest. Use social media polls or direct outreach. The goal is to get signal before investing significant time and resources into building something nobody wants.

prompts.title: Audience Definition Prompt
prompts.text: I want you to act as a market research expert. Help me define my ideal audience by asking targeted questions about who they are, what they struggle with, and what outcomes they desire. Start by asking me to describe the general niche or industry I operate in, then probe deeper to narrow down to a specific, addressable audience segment.

prompts.title: Offer Ideation Prompt
prompts.text: Act as a product strategist. Based on the audience I describe, help me brainstorm 3-5 potential offers that would provide immediate value. For each offer, outline: (1) the specific problem it solves, (2) the format it could take, (3) why it would be easy to deliver quickly, and (4) how it could lead to a larger offer later.

templates.title: Audience Profile Canvas
templates.description: A structured template to document your ideal audience demographics, psychographics, and pain points.

templates.title: Offer Validation Scorecard
templates.description: Evaluate and score potential offers based on demand, differentiation, and deliverability.

resources.title: Audience Research Toolkit
resources.description: A curated list of tools for finding and analyzing your target audience online.

resources.title: The Mom Test by Rob Fitzpatrick
resources.description: Essential reading on how to validate ideas by talking to customers without biased feedback.

modules.title: Offer Design
modules.description: Design a compelling offer that converts visitors into paying customers.
outcome: Structure a high-converting offer
Price your offer strategically
Write persuasive offer copy

steps.title: Structure Your Offer
steps.description: Package your solution into a clear, compelling offer structure.
steps.details: Break your offer into components: the core deliverable, any bonuses, and the guarantee. Make sure each component adds perceived value. Use the value stack approach where the total perceived value significantly exceeds the price point.

steps.title: Set Your Pricing
steps.description: Determine a price that reflects value while remaining accessible to your audience.
steps.details: Consider value-based pricing rather than cost-plus. Research what comparable offers sell for in your market. Test different price points if possible. Remember that pricing signals quality and commitment.

steps.title: Write Persuasive Copy
steps.description: Craft messaging that communicates value and drives action.
steps.details: Focus on benefits over features. Address objections head-on. Use social proof where available. Write in a conversational tone that speaks directly to your ideal audience. Include a clear call to action.

prompts.title: Offer Structure Prompt
prompts.text: Act as a direct-response copywriter. Help me structure a high-converting offer by walking through the following: (1) Core promise what is the single most important outcome, (2) Value stack list 5-7 components that build perceived value, (3) Risk reversal what guarantee removes the most friction, (4) Scarcity what makes this offer time-sensitive or limited.

prompts.title: Pricing Strategy Prompt
prompts.text: Act as a pricing strategist. Help me determine the optimal price for my offer. Consider: the depth of transformation provided, comparable offers in the market, the audience ability to pay, and the perceived value of the outcomes. Suggest 3 price tiers and explain the psychological positioning of each.

templates.title: Offer Architecture Blueprint
templates.description: A framework for structuring your core offer, bonuses, and guarantees.

resources.title: Value-Based Pricing Guide
resources.description: Learn how to price based on the value you deliver rather than time or cost.

resources.title: Copywriting Formulas Library
resources.description: A collection of proven copywriting frameworks (PAS, AIDA, FAB, etc.).

modules.title: Content Engine
modules.description: Build a systematic content creation machine that consistently produces high-quality material.
outcome: Develop a content strategy that aligns with your offer
Create a repeatable content production workflow
Establish a content calendar you can sustain

steps.title: Define Content Pillars
steps.description: Identify 3-5 content themes that support your offer and resonate with your audience.
steps.details: Content pillars are broad topics that you will consistently create content around. Each pillar should connect back to your core offer while providing standalone value. Aim for a mix of educational, inspirational, and promotional content across your pillars.

steps.title: Build a Production Workflow
steps.description: Create a repeatable process for turning ideas into published content.
steps.details: Map out each stage of content creation from ideation to publication. Define specifically what happens at each stage. Use templates and checklists to eliminate decision fatigue. Batch similar tasks together to stay in flow state longer.

steps.title: Set Your Content Calendar
steps.description: Plan your content schedule to ensure consistent output without burnout.
steps.details: Decide on your publishing frequency realistically. Create a content calendar template that maps out what gets published when. Include buffer time for unexpected delays. Start with a sustainable cadence and scale up gradually.

prompts.title: Content Pillar Generator
prompts.text: Act as a content strategist. Based on my offer and audience, help me define 5 content pillars. For each pillar, provide: (1) the pillar name and description, (2) 5-10 specific content ideas within that pillar, (3) how it connects to my core offer, and (4) which format works best (video, written, audio).

prompts.title: Content Repurposing Prompt
prompts.text: Act as a content operations expert. Given a single piece of long-form content I create, outline a systematic repurposing workflow that transforms it into: social media posts, email newsletter content, short-form video scripts, images, and discussion questions. Show me the exact step-by-step process.

templates.title: Content Calendar Template
templates.description: A structured calendar for planning and tracking all your content across platforms.

templates.title: Content Brief Template
templates.description: A brief that ensures every piece of content serves a strategic purpose and stays on brand.

resources.title: Hemingway App
resources.description: A tool to make your writing bold and clear by highlighting complex sentences.

resources.title: Repurposing Workflow Guide
resources.description: A step-by-step guide to repurposing one piece of content into 10+ formats.

modules.title: SEO Engine
modules.description: Optimize your content to be discovered organically through search engines.
outcome: Conduct keyword research that drives traffic
Optimize content for search engines
Build a sustainable organic growth channel

steps.title: Conduct Keyword Research
steps.description: Find the right keywords that your audience is searching for.
steps.details: Start with seed keywords related to your topic. Use keyword research tools to find related terms, long-tail variations, and questions people ask. Prioritize keywords based on search volume, relevance, and competition level. Build a keyword map that connects each piece of content to specific search intents.

steps.title: Optimize Your Content
steps.description: Apply on-page SEO best practices to every piece of content you publish.
steps.details: Focus on title tags, meta descriptions, heading structure, URL structure, and internal linking. Ensure your content comprehensively answers the search query. Use related keywords naturally throughout. Optimize images with descriptive alt text and proper file names.

steps.title: Build Authority Signals
steps.description: Establish credibility through strategic linking and relationship building.
steps.details: Develop a link building strategy that focuses on quality over quantity. Create linkable assets like original research, comprehensive guides, and data visualizations. Engage in strategic partnerships and guest content opportunities that drive relevant referral traffic.

prompts.title: Keyword Research Prompt
prompts.text: Act as an SEO strategist. Given my niche and audience, help me build a keyword strategy. Generate: (1) 20 seed keywords, (2) 50 long-tail variations, (3) 20 question-based keywords people ask, and (4) a keyword map organized by search intent (informational, navigational, transactional).

prompts.title: On-Page SEO Audit Prompt
prompts.text: Act as an SEO auditor. Review my content and provide specific recommendations for: title tag optimization, meta description improvements, heading structure fixes, internal linking opportunities, content gaps, and technical SEO issues. Provide actionable before/after examples.

templates.title: Keyword Research Tracker
templates.description: A spreadsheet template for tracking keywords by volume, difficulty, and content assigned.

templates.title: SEO Content Brief Template
templates.description: An SEO-optimized content brief that ensures every article targets the right keywords.

checklist.label: Optimize title tags and meta descriptions
Add internal links to related content
Set up search console and analytics

resources.title: Google Search Console
resources.description: Monitor your search performance and identify optimization opportunities.

resources.title: Ahrefs Webmaster Tools
resources.description: Free SEO tools for keyword research, backlink analysis, and site audits.

modules.title: Distribution
modules.description: Systematically distribute your content across the right channels to maximize reach.
outcome: Build a multi-channel distribution system
Automate content syndication
Track and optimize channel performance

steps.title: Select Your Channels
steps.description: Choose the platforms where your audience spends their time.
steps.details: Don't try to be everywhere at once. Pick 2-3 primary channels where your target audience is most active. Consider the content format that works best on each platform. Focus on depth on fewer channels rather than surface-level presence everywhere.

steps.title: Set Up Syndication
steps.description: Create a system for republishing content across your chosen channels.
steps.details: For each piece of content, identify the primary platform and secondary syndication targets. Adapt the format for each platform while maintaining the core message. Use tools and workflows to automate cross-posting where appropriate.

steps.title: Track Performance
steps.description: Measure what matters and double down on what works.
steps.details: Set up tracking for each distribution channel. Define the key metrics that matter for each platform. Review performance weekly and adjust your strategy based on data. Kill underperforming channels and invest more in what works.

prompts.title: Distribution Strategy Prompt
prompts.text: Act as a distribution strategist. Based on my audience profile and content type, recommend: (1) the top 3 platforms I should focus on, (2) the optimal posting frequency for each, (3) the content format that performs best on each platform, and (4) a cross-posting strategy that maximizes reach without duplication penalties.

templates.title: Distribution Calendar
templates.description: A calendar template for scheduling cross-platform content distribution.

resources.title: Buffer
resources.description: Schedule and publish content across social media platforms from one dashboard.

resources.title: Distribution Channel Guide
resources.description: A comparison of major content distribution platforms and their best use cases.

modules.title: Conversion
modules.description: Turn your audience into customers with a frictionless conversion system.
outcome: Design a conversion funnel that guides visitors to purchase
Create email sequences that nurture and convert
Optimize conversion rates through testing

steps.title: Design Your Conversion Funnel
steps.description: Map the journey from first touch to purchase.
steps.details: Every piece of content should lead somewhere. Design clear next steps at each stage of the customer journey. Remove friction points where people drop off. Create logical progressions from free content to low-commitment offers to core products.

steps.title: Build Email Sequences
steps.description: Create automated email flows that nurture subscribers into customers.
steps.details: Map out the key sequences: welcome sequence, content nurture sequence, offer sequence, and re-engagement sequence. Each email should have a clear purpose and single call to action. Write conversationally, provide value first, and promote strategically.

steps.title: Optimize Conversion Rate
steps.description: Systematically test and improve each step of your conversion process.
steps.details: Identify the key conversion points in your funnel. Set up A/B tests for headlines, calls to action, pricing presentation, and page layouts. Focus on one variable at a time. Let tests run long enough to reach statistical significance.

prompts.title: Email Sequence Generator
prompts.text: Act as an email marketing strategist. Help me create a 5-email welcome sequence that: (1) delivers immediate value, (2) establishes authority, (3) shares my story and mission, (4) introduces my core offer naturally, and (5) includes a clear call to action. For each email, provide subject line options and the main body structure.

prompts.title: Conversion Audit Prompt
prompts.text: Act as a conversion rate optimization specialist. Audit my current conversion process and identify: (1) the top 3 friction points causing drop-off, (2) 5 specific changes I can make to improve conversion, (3) the highest-impact test I should run first, and (4) an ideal conversion flow redesign recommendation.

templates.title: Email Sequence Blueprint
templates.description: A framework for planning and structuring automated email sequences.

templates.title: Conversion Funnel Map
templates.description: Visual template for mapping your full conversion funnel from awareness to purchase.

resources.title: Email Marketing Platforms Comparison
resources.description: A comparison of popular email marketing platforms with pricing and feature analysis.

modules.title: Resources
modules.description: Access the full toolkit of templates, prompts, and references to support your growth system.
outcome: Access all system templates and frameworks
Download ready-to-use prompts for AI tools
Build a personal resource library for ongoing execution

steps.title: Organize Your Resources
steps.description: Set up your personal system for accessing and organizing these resources.
steps.details: Create a folder structure or digital workspace where you can easily access all templates, prompts, and tools. Organize by module for quick reference. Set up bookmarks and shortcuts to your most-used resources.

steps.title: Customize Templates
steps.description: Adapt each template to fit your specific brand and workflow.
steps.details: Go through each template and customize it with your brand colors, logo, and voice. Adjust the structure to match your specific workflow. The templates are starting points, not final products. Make them yours.

steps.title: Build Your Stack
steps.description: Select and configure the tools that will power your growth system.
steps.details: Review the recommended tools and choose the ones that fit your workflow and budget. Set up integrations between tools to automate repetitive tasks. Create a simple dashboard where you can monitor your key metrics at a glance.

prompts.title: Tool Stack Evaluation Prompt
prompts.text: Act as a tech stack consultant. Based on my growth system requirements, help me evaluate and select the right tools. Consider: content creation, scheduling, analytics, email marketing, and community management. For each category, recommend a free/affordable option and a pro option, explaining the tradeoffs.

templates.description: A comprehensive checklist for setting up all the tools and systems in this blueprint.
